en-US.description: Awoo Installer and GoldLeaf uploader of the NSPs (and other files), RCM payload injector, application for split/merge files.
en-US.name: NS-USBloader
en-US.releaseNotes:
Changes:
- Move to JDK 23, OpenJFX 25
- Fix #183: CLI does not work on headless systems since v7.1. Thank you, @connesc
- Windows drivers updated: libusbK v3.1.0.0
- usb4java updated to 1.3.0 with a custom libusb4java build based on libusb 1.0.30.
  -legacy remains on usb4java 1.2.0 with all-default libusb.
- Improved stability on: Windows x86-64, macOS (Apple Silicon & Intel), Linux (amd64/aarch64/RPi ARMv7). macOS users should no longer need a separate brew install libusb. On Windows x86 (non-64) use -legacy.
- Fix #190: Version in winget reported as Unknown. By @HarmfulBreeze. Thank you!
- Windows installer: full and clean uninstall. Fixed incorrect handling of the user-selected installation locations
- Fix: Goldleaf 'Create' command handling and few minor bugs
Translations:
- @DDinghoya added new labels and updated existing ones in Korean locale. Thank you!
- @segured928 translated application to Catalan. Thank you!
- @batuhanmeral completed and corrected Turkish translation. Thank you!
Also:
- @davidebeatrici added repology badge to README
- Refactoring: unification of USB interaction, Awoo net-install code rewritten. Maybe something will be faster.
- Project build flow updated to use maven profiles replacing ad-hoc script logic
